verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a manual review queue (Verifications page in Customer Portal), decision webhooks, and user-defined-status webhooks that feed reviewer decisions back into the record, but there's no explicit description of the full evidence bundle (document images + extracted fields + check results) being presented together in the review UI, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of the workflow. missing for 10: documentation of the review UI showing combined document images, extracted fields, and check results in one view, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of the manual review + feedback loop.
